__comment: Copy this file to config.local.json and fill in imageApiKey. Run: pip install openai. pythonBin may be 'python' or 'python3'. imagePromptModel is the high-level model (e.g. 'opus') used by the prompt-crafting subagent. imageBackup* are an optional fallback image provider, tried only when the primary request fails or returns a non-image.
